description: Auto-check ds-rescue binary on SessionStart; offer install if missing

hooks.command: test -x "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/ds-rescue" || command -v ds-rescue >/dev/null || echo "⚠ ds-rescue binary not installed. Recommended: go install github.com/zred0627/ds-rescue-cc/cmd/ds-rescue@latest (works on all OSes incl. Windows SAC). Alternative: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zred0627/ds-rescue-cc/main/scripts/install.sh | sh"
